identity.notes: The official location page and its directly linked SkyTab ordering surface identify the same operating restaurant, street address, and 301-294-0200 phone number. Other Clyde's locations are separate and are not merged.

sources.excerpt: Official Tower Oaks Lodge page confirms the operating Rockville restaurant, address, phone, hours, menu tabs, current PDF links, and direct SkyTab ordering link.
Official locations directory distinguishes Tower Oaks Lodge from Clyde's sibling restaurants, including Chevy Chase, Georgetown, Mark Center, and Willow Creek Farm.
Current two-page Tower Oaks Lunch & Dinner PDF supplies the exhaustive lunch/dinner food surface, selected nonalcoholic beverages, dietary labels, and the allergy/cross-contact notice.
Current two-page Tower Oaks Brunch PDF supplies the current brunch surface and repeats the dietary legend and allergy/cross-contact notice.

Current Tower Oaks beverage document was inspected in full. Named spirit-free cocktails, nonalcoholic beer and sparkling wine, waters, sodas, juices, coffee, and tea are in scope; alcohol-only sections are excluded.
Current Tower Oaks dessert document supplies the exhaustive dessert and classic milkshake surface; boozy milkshakes and other alcohol-only sections are excluded.

The official Order Online link resolves to Clyde's Tower Oaks Lodge at 2 Preserve Pkwy, Rockville. Its live categories corroborate the core menu and add four current named products absent from the official PDFs.
Fresh exact-location and official-domain searches found the current menus but no comprehensive official product-by-allergen matrix.

attempts.query: Freshly inspect the exact Tower Oaks location page, every menu tab, the locations directory, and navigation for allergen, allergy, ingredient, nutrition, dietary, and cross-contact resources.
attempts.outcome: The official site confirms the exact operating identity and current menu boundaries. It publishes Vegetarian and Gluten-Friendly labels plus a restaurant-level allergy/cross-contact notice, but no comprehensive product-by-allergen matrix.

attempts.query: Open and visually inspect every current Tower Oaks food, brunch, beverage, dessert, coffee, tea, and kids menu document or tab and search the official domain for allergen, ingredient, nutrition, gluten-free, vegetarian, vegan, and PDF resources.
attempts.outcome: The current documents enumerate the full official menu and provide descriptive ingredients and a gluten-handling caution. No comprehensive official allergen matrix, full ingredient table, or nutrition table was found.

attempts.query: Freshly follow the official Tower Oaks Order Online link and inspect the exact-address SkyTab categories, products, descriptions, dietary labels, and downloadable resources.
attempts.outcome: The linked SkyTab surface matches the exact Tower Oaks address, corroborates the current menu, and adds four named products absent from the official PDFs. It exposes no comprehensive allergen matrix or cross-contact guide.

attempts.query: Clyde's at Tower Oaks Lodge Rockville allergen allergy ingredients nutrition menu PDF; site:clydes.com Tower Oaks allergen allergy gluten-free vegetarian PDF.
attempts.outcome: Targeted exact-location and official-domain searches surfaced the current official menus and no current restaurant-issued comprehensive allergen matrix.

matrixSearch.notes: All four required search classes were completed. Direct positive allergens are retained only where named ingredients or the food identity make them explicit. Products without direct positive evidence remain unavailable; Vegetarian or Gluten-Friendly labels are not converted into allergen-absence claims.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: The current food menus identify select products as Vegetarian or Gluten-Friendly.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: These are dietary menu labels, not comprehensive allergen-absence guarantees.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: Clyde's says it takes care to avoid cross-contact but that the kitchen is not completely gluten-free.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: This facility-level caution must not be expanded into blanket product-level may-contain claims.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: Guests are instructed to inform their server before ordering if they have a food allergy or dietary need.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: This is a communication instruction, not a safety guarantee.

findings.summary: The official location page and its directly linked SkyTab surface confirm the same operating Clyde's at Tower Oaks Lodge at 2 Preserve Parkway, Rockville, Maryland. Sibling Clyde's restaurants are separate identities.

The exact in-scope union is 134 distinct current products: 78 lunch/dinner/brunch foods, seven kids items, 15 desserts and classic milkshakes, 30 nonalcoholic drinks/coffee/tea, and four linked-SkyTab supplements.

The 175-row frozen catalog combines Tower Oaks material with Toast menus for Chevy Chase, Georgetown, Mark Center, and Willow Creek Farm. Foreign-only rows are classified as location mismatches unless a current Tower Oaks equivalent independently exists.

Portion labels, platter counts, add-on modifiers, description fragments, a section heading, a promotion heading, and duplicated rib/crab-cake/burger presentations are reconciled to canonical current products or removed as artifacts.
No comprehensive official product-by-allergen matrix was found after all four required searches. Direct positive ingredient evidence is preserved, and unsupported negatives are not inferred.

The current food PDFs identify select Vegetarian and Gluten-Friendly products and state that the kitchen is not completely gluten-free despite care to avoid cross-contact. This is retained only at restaurant level.

proposedChanges: Replace the contaminated frozen union with the 134-product exact-location current Tower Oaks union and exclude sibling-location-only rows.
Collapse portion, platter-count, and menu-option variants into canonical products; remove modifiers, description fragments, headings, and the alcohol-only flavor artifact.
Publish direct positive allergens only where supported by current official or restaurant-linked product language; keep all other product allergens unavailable.

claims.facilityCrossContact: Kitchen is not completely gluten-free; care is taken to avoid cross-contact.
claims.guestInstruction: Inform the server of food allergies or dietary needs before ordering.

proposedChanges.notes: Do not infer allergen absence from Vegetarian or Gluten-Friendly labels, and do not expand the facility notice into blanket product-level may-contain claims.
